text: CALL TO ORDER: 9:49 a.m. Speaker Nunziata took the Chair and called the Members to order. The meeting opened with O Canada. September 28, 2022 Speaker Nunziata called upon Mayor Tory to address City Council about the passing of Her Majesty Queen Elizabeth II. Mayor Tory addressed City Council and acknowledged that September 8, 2022 marked the sad loss of Her Majesty Queen Elizabeth II, Canada's Head of State after 70 remarkable years on the throne. Mayor Tory remarked that Queen Elizabeth II was the longest reigning monarch in British history, was the longest reigning female monarch as well as the second longest reigning monarch in world history. Mayor Tory spoke of Her Majesty's long, extraordinary life that she gave to public service.
